name: Mankitsu Happening
source:
After a string of failed jobs, Keiichi Oyamada lands work at a small manga cafe. Things seem to be looking up from day one. His best friend is his manager and he gets to work alongside the beautiful Rei Suzukawa. Also, his cute childhood friend, Kururu Hiiragi, is a regular—and she's all grown up!

So why couldn't Keiichi hold down a job before? Due to a series of bizarre coincidences, he always seems to end up having sex with every single female coworker! Although he hopes to finally end this deadly cycle, Keiichi will soon find out that bad habits die hard.
translation:
在经历了一系列失败的工作后，小山田圭一在一家小型漫画咖啡馆找到了工作。事情似乎从第一天起就开始好转。他最好的朋友是他的经理，他可以和美丽的铃川丽一起工作。此外，他可爱的童年好友柊库鲁鲁 (Kururu Hiiragi) 也是常客，而且她已经长大了！

那么惠一之前为什么保不住工作呢？由于一系列离奇的巧合，他似乎总是和每一个女同事都发生关系！尽管庆一希望最终结束这个致命的循环，但他很快就会发现坏习惯很难改掉。
